button.label: Create Guide
button.supertip: Captures the previous slide as a semi-transparent overlay on the current slide so you can line up animation.

button.label: Clear Guide
button.supertip: Deletes the onion-skin guide on the current slide only.

button.label: Clear All Guides
button.supertip: Deletes every onion-skin guide shape from this presentation.

menu.label: Animation Mode
menu.supertip: Choose what happens automatically when a new slide is created. The active mode is highlighted by PowerPoint. Background Shapes tools are available only when a mode other than Off is selected.

toggleButton.label: Off
toggleButton.supertip: New slides are created normally. Background shape tools are disabled while Off is selected.

toggleButton.label: Classic
toggleButton.supertip: Each new slide receives a semi-transparent guide from the previous slide.

toggleButton.label: Duplicate
toggleButton.supertip: Each new slide is filled with a copy of the previous slide and also receives an onion-skin guide underneath.

button.label: Set Background
button.supertip: Creates locked background copies behind the selected shapes. The chosen figures stay editable on this slide. Use the menu to choose whether that background repeats on every new slide when you press Enter.

toggleButton.screentip: Repeat locked background on every new slide
toggleButton.supertip: When On, each time you insert a new slide (Enter), a locked copy of the background shapes is copied from the previous slide. This does not change existing slides — only new ones. When Off, that automatic copy is skipped (guide / duplicate behaviour still runs).

button.label: Clear Background
button.screentip: Clear background marks on this slide
button.supertip: Removes background marks from all background shapes on the current slide and unlocks them.

button.label: Clear background on all slides
button.supertip: Removes background marks from every background shape in the presentation and unlocks them.

button.label: Remove from Background
button.supertip: Removes the background mark from the selected shapes only and unlocks them.

button.label: Export GIF
button.supertip: Quickly exports the presentation as an animated GIF. Onion-skin guides are hidden so they don't appear in the output. Use the dropdown for other formats or to keep guides visible.

menu.label: GIF
menu.supertip: Renders the deck as an animated GIF using PowerPoint's built-in encoder.

button.label: No guides
button.supertip: Renders an animated GIF with every onion-skin guide stripped out. Saves to the configured output folder.

button.label: With guides
button.supertip: Renders an animated GIF with the onion-skin guides baked in. Saves to the configured output folder.

menu.label: Video
menu.supertip: Renders the deck as an MP4 (1080p, 30fps) using PowerPoint's built-in encoder. Slide timings and narrations are respected.

button.label: No guides
button.supertip: Renders an MP4 with every onion-skin guide stripped out. Saves to the configured output folder.

button.label: With guides
button.supertip: Renders an MP4 with the onion-skin guides baked in. Saves to the configured output folder.

button.label: Set output folder...
button.supertip: Pick the folder where exported GIFs and MP4s should be saved. Defaults to the same folder as the active presentation (or Desktop if it has not been saved).
